profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II
profile.summary:
As a software developer I appreciate the opportunity to explore my passion for problem solving creatively and technically. I strive to engineer positive user experiences through beautifully simplistic user interfaces and data management.

Apart from development & design I enjoy photography, brain games and watching/playing sports.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: A pop-up agency organizing creative projects for lasting impact. Good Measure provides hands-on strategic consulting and design services, facilitates workshop sessions, and hosts brand sprints throughout the nation that inspire and give creatives a chance to give back in the most convenient ways possible. Each local Good Measure project revamps nonprofits and for-good endeavors over the course of 72 hours—all for free.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
* safeR: 
 - React app with a React Native companion, complete with geolocation, that allows users to anonymously report local incidents. 
 - https://safer.netlify.com/

* Foodie Phonetics: 
 - Implemented a spaced repetition algorithm using a singly linked list within a REST API that allows users to learn common French food items in English.
 - https://foodiephonetics.netlify.com/
 
* For The Win
 - Single page app that uses multiple NBA feeds from a 3rd party API as users track team stats and schedules in a fantasy basketball league.
 - https://for-the-win-app.netlify.com/

positions.title: Brand Identity Designer & Photographer
positions.description:
* Design and execute visual brand identities, including logos, print collateral, style guides and user interfaces.
* Perform market research and develop user personas to plan a better user experience.
* Apparel designer for businesses and non-profit organizations.
* Retain repeat business by properly managing client relations.
* Responsible for all of my own marketing and website updates.
* Arrange photoshoots and design invitations for multiple events.
* Photograph headshots used in professional publications.
* Capture, cull and edit digital and mobile photography.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
* Collaborate on the naming of, logo design, and web design of an upcoming agricultural company.
* Develop a style guide, stationary specs and digital assets for Voila Montessori.

positions.title: Technical Support Technician
positions.description:
* Wrote and edited documentation that Customer Care & Retail employees used for troubleshooting.
* Managed client and employee relationships remotely.
* Tracked and resolved client issues through JIRA tickets.
* Trained new departmental employees and assisted in cross training with other departments. 
* Responsible and respectful Tier II team member.
* Provided weekly feedback to Tier I management on how agents could improve their client resolution process.
* Advocated for my regional clients via network testing.
* Support Corporate Employee data device needs.
* Recognize patterns from calls and tickets to find root causes.
* Retail store visits to collect data and disseminate information. 
* Created reliable customer experiences through the discovery of flaws in vendor or internal processes.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description:
* Troubleshoot customer problems over the phone with SMS, MMS, dropped calls, data and voice as they pertain to the network. 
* Become familiar with the HLR, RF, Provisioning, Syniverse and various other reports.
* Provide Tier II troubleshooting knowledge for escalated calls from  Customer Care.

positions.title: Discover Center Specialist
positions.description:
* Learning Leader: responsible for training fellow co-workers on new policies and procedures.
* Integrate technology into our customer’s lives.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting and customer demos. 
* Key holder and bank runner.

positions.title: Account Service Representative
positions.description: I used my interpersonal communicative skills as a means to reach sales and accessory quotas, retain new customers and do basic troubleshooting. I also completed basic training with the customer about their device.

positions.title: Contributing Writer
positions.description: Contributing writer on pslovecharli.com, "a savvy online lifestyle magazine", as the Art & Photography expert.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
* Spearheaded the creation and maintenance of an online blog.
* Served as a documentary photographer to Will Sterling in studio and on location.
* Sharpened my eye for composition, photo editing, concept creation and layout design.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Under the direction of Christy Chamblee, Art Director, I was responsible for tasks ranging from research and brainstorming to assisting in the completion of projects.
